standard.summary: LoRA 权重文件的保存目录。训练完成后，最终 LoRA 和所有中间 checkpoint 保存在此目录下。
standard.effect: 目录不存在时自动创建。支持绝对路径和相对路径（相对于训练器工作目录）。
standard.whenToUse: 每次训练建议使用独立的输出目录，便于区分不同实验的结果。
standard.avoidWhen: 多个训练任务共用同一输出目录时，文件名可能冲突，建议使用不同目录或不同 output_name。

standard_en.summary: The directory the LoRA weight files are saved in. When training finishes, the final LoRA and every intermediate checkpoint live here.
standard_en.effect: The directory is created if it does not exist. Absolute and relative paths are both supported (relative to the trainer's working directory).
standard_en.whenToUse: A separate output directory per run is recommended, so different experiments' results stay distinguishable.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When several training jobs share one output directory the filenames may collide; use different directories or different output_name values.

advanced.principle: 输出文件命名规则：{output_name}-{step}.safetensors（中间）/ {output_name}.safetensors（最终）。EMA 文件额外添加 _ema 后缀。
advanced.tradeoffs: 磁盘空间需要留足：每个 16-rank LoRA 约 20~80MB，64-rank 约 80~320MB；若频繁保存 checkpoint 需要预留更多空间。

advanced_en.principle: Output file naming: {output_name}-{step}.safetensors (intermediate) / {output_name}.safetensors (final). EMA files additionally get an _ema suffix.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Leave enough disk space: a 16-rank LoRA is about 20~80MB, 64-rank about 80~320MB; frequent checkpoint saving needs more headroom.
